How to start composting at home

By A. Gardener

Composting turns kitchen scraps and garden waste into rich soil. The process relies on a balance of green material, such as vegetable peelings and grass cuttings, and brown material, such as dry leaves, cardboard and straw. Microbes break the mixture down, generating heat as they work, and the pile shrinks over several months. Step 1: keep the heap moist like a wrung-out sponge and turn it every few weeks so air reaches the middle.
